The first cell must match the original idle's scale and neutral guard proportions. Do not turn her into a male fighter or narrow her clothing. Every figure must be fully inside the canvas.

Strict constraints: actual transparent alpha; exactly 16 separate full-body figures; no touching figures, floor, smoke, projectiles, effects, props, logos, lettering, watermark, photorealism, 3D, copied commercial sprites, missing limbs, extra limbs, fused figures or independent cell resizing.
